messages:
deploy-bot: promotion blocked in ap-southeast-1 for release 'payments/2025-05-03' — chart provenance verification failed: signature verification error for chart 'redwood/payment-gateway' v2.3.0. reason: key id rotated. automated fallback: NONE.

mike: what region(s) affected?

deploy-bot: ap-southeast-1 only. other regions passed verification.

anna: 👀 looks like the signing key used to sign charts was rotated last night in our artifact-pipeline. new key hasn't been propagated to the regional validator cluster in ap-southeast-1 yet.

jessica: if the chart can't be verified we can't promote the chart version. can we promote the image separately (image-only promotion) and pin the chart to v2.2.9 for that region?

sam: image-only works functionally but we need to check helm values overlays — the v2.3.0 chart introduced a values ref for DB_SECRET_PATH that our overlay in ap-southeast-1 relies on. promoting an older chart might drop that new values key.

anna: good catch. change in v2.3.0: added credentials.path -> values.db.secretPath. overlay in ap-southeast-1 currently sets `credentials.path` (old key). So if we pin to 2.2.9 the overlay will be applied to the older key and the app will still read from credentials.path. but the runtime config expects secretPath (v2.3.0) — hmm mismatch.

infra-bot: quick check: running `helm template redwood/payment-gateway --version 2.2.9 -f overlays/ap-southeast-1.yaml | grep secretPath || true` → NO MATCH. `helm template --version 2.3.0` → MATCHES `values.db.secretPath: /secrets/payments`.

mike: so pinning chart => values key mismatch. image-only promotion => container has code expecting secretPath. That will break.

jessica: options: 1) wait for key propagation (ETA ~30m) and resume normal promotion; 2) hotpatch overlay in ap-southeast-1 to map `credentials.path` -> `/secrets/payments` for v2.3.0 compatibility and then promote image+chart; 3) promote image-only and inject compatibility shim as a ConfigMap in that region (fast hack).

sam: option 2 is safest (hotpatch overlay). who can assemble a minimal overlay?

anna: I can prepare overlay patch now. will add a small values shim: `credentials: { path: /secrets/payments }` and a note in release notes.

jessica: AND we should update release notes + rollback plan: if hotpatch causes issue, we will revert overlay and abort promotion within the next 10 minutes of the canary. set canary fraction to 0 immediately if we see errors.

mike: I created a short checklist in the thread:
```
1) propagate signing key to ap-southeast-1 (infra team) — infra-bot to confirm
2) apply overlay shim in ap-southeast-1 (anna)
3) re-run deploy-bot promotion job in region
4) monitor canary logs & SLOs for 15m, rollback if errors > 1%  
5) update release notes to document shim + follow-up cleanup
```

infra-bot: key propagation job started. estimated sync: 14 minutes.

anna: overlay patch pushed to staging branch: `hotfix/apac-chart-shim-1758888888`. I'll open a quick PR and apply to the canary namespace.

deploy-bot: manual promotion queued for ap-southeast-1 after `chart-signature-check` passes.

jessica: i'm going to add a release-note bullet: "ap-southeast-1 temporary values shim applied due to chart-signing key rotation; cleanup planned after key sync".

sam: also add rollback steps: chart rollback command snippet and image rollback pointer.

anna: applied shim to canary namespace. helm diff shows only values map change.

infra-bot: signing key now propagated to ap-southeast-1. verify step passing.

deploy-bot: promotion resumed and succeeded for ap-southeast-1 canary (fraction 5%).

mike: monitor for 15m and then ramp if healthy. :thumbsup:

jessica: will update release notes and add cleanup ticket to remove shim after next stable chart rotation. :memo:

sam: good coordination. put a follow-up on eng-releases for postmortem on key propagation process. :eyes:

deploy-bot: note: pinned-chart-no-longer-needed flag set to false.

anna: filing cleanup PR now. thanks all. :tada:
